name: Carson Smith
summary: Dog groomer with more than two years of hands-on shop experience, a Groom Texas Best First Timer Award, and returning clients who request me by name. Bring a patient approach to working with dogs, an eye for finishing details, and a commitment to learning.

experience.tenure: More than two years of shop experience
highlights: Progressed from primarily bathing dogs to taking on an increasing number of grooms.
Bathe, brush and comb dogs as part of coat preparation and grooming.
Shape coats, faces, ears and legs with careful scissor finishing and attention to each outline.
Create rounded heads, styled topknots and tidy body trims, with bows and other finishing details.
Build repeat-client relationships, with customers specifically asking for me at the shop.

award.title: Best First Timer Award
award.description: Earned this award for grooming Fabrice, a Bichon Frise. Featured with Fabrice in Fabrice’s Big Grooming Day, a children’s book by his owner, Michele Stoudt-Wright.

training: Built grooming skills through several training courses and day-to-day shop experience. Continue practicing coat shaping and finishing techniques.
animalExperience: Fostered many puppies and care for my corgi, Beauregard, and horse, Chief Hopper. Began riding at about age eight and earned numerous awards in horse jumping.
